body.statement: There is no \((1-o(1))\ln|V|\) approximation scheme for the ordinary minimum-cost intervention problem unless \(\mathrm{NP}\) has quasi-polynomial-time algorithms.

source.verbatim_statement: There is no (1−o(1)) ln|V| approximation scheme
